visual_verdict: Substantial reduction in high-frequency speckle. Broad muted soil clusters and sparse chips/scuffs survive native reconstruction. Repeated broad patterns remain perceptible.
edge_verdict: Opposite edges are not equal. Left/right join MAD3.469 exceeds internal horizontal1.414; top/bottom MAD0.807 is below internal vertical1.443. Absolute contrast is low, but no seamless claim is made.
rejected_claims: No final gameplay acceptance from a texture preview.
root_review: Root viewed comparison and repeated4x preview and accepted this source for a production trial, with the repeated-pattern/seam caveat.
